review.notes: All 26 physical pages compared word-by-word against the OCR Markdown; no code fences. Page 3 footnotes verified on a 300 dpi crop; page 26 contributor continuation verified on the rendered page. Word-level differences beyond the two patches are LaTeX math, soft-hyphen line breaks, and storage-infra figure labels (Babit Multimedia Framework, Tidal, HDFS on p.8). The PDF itself prints the typos 'devide/aquire/abilitity/adpot' (p.5) and 'proprerly' (p.7) in Prompt Engineering prose; OCR silently corrected three of them while keeping 'adpot'. Treated as author typos printed by the PDF and left unchanged per the no-author-typo-patch rule; flagged here in case the project later decides OCR must mirror the printed spelling.

patches.evidence: The 300 dpi crop of physical p.3 prints two page footnotes '1https://www.doubao.com/chat/create-video' and '2https://jimeng.jianying.com/ai-tool/video/generate' below the sentence that ends '...daily creative applications.'; the OCR kept the Doubao/Jimeng markers as superscripts but dropped both footnote bodies. The patch restores the printed footnote lines after the referencing sentence.
